cases.purpose: Reject malformed, negative and overflowing descriptors and invalid setter arguments without changing fd 0.
cases.oracle: Shell status and diagnostics, plus Linux /proc fdinfo observed independently before and after invalid calls.
cases.comparison: Every invalid descriptor returns usage status 2 with its own invalid diagnostic; invalid modes and extra arguments return 2; fd 0 flags remain unchanged.
cases.script:
set -u
owner=$BASHPID
observe() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import sys; print(next(line.split()[1] for line in open("/proc/%s/fdinfo/0" % sys.argv[1]) if line.startswith("flags:")))' "$owner"; }
before=$(observe) || exit 10
for value in nonsense '' -1 2147483648 999999999999999999999999 1x; do
  for cmd in set-nonblock clear-cloexec close; do
    if [[ $cmd == set-nonblock ]]; then
      builtin bashpoll "$cmd" "$value" on 2>diagnostic; rc=$?
    else
      builtin bashpoll "$cmd" "$value" 2>diagnostic; rc=$?
    fi
    [[ $rc == 2 ]] && [[ $(<diagnostic) == *invalid* ]] || exit 11
  done
done
after=$(observe) || exit 12
[[ $before == "$after" ]] || exit 13
for mode in invalid '' ON; do
  builtin bashpoll set-nonblock 0 "$mode" 2>diagnostic; rc=$?
  [[ $rc == 2 ]] && [[ -s diagnostic ]] || exit 14
done
builtin bashpoll set-nonblock 0 on extra 2>diagnostic; rc=$?
[[ $rc == 2 ]] || exit 15
builtin bashpoll clear-cloexec 0 extra 2>diagnostic; rc=$?
[[ $rc == 2 ]] || exit 16
after=$(observe) || exit 17
[[ $before == "$after" ]] || exit 18
printf 'invalid descriptor and mode rejected; fd 0 unchanged\n'
cases.stdout: invalid descriptor and mode rejected; fd 0 unchanged
